description: Election Commission - Declare that P. E. Fernando as a member of he Nattandiya P/S
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's absence from meetings, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under election-related administrative matters.
